decisions_recap: Fold from the rail's own title and leave a handle; the header stays bare.
The fold slides — width + transform only, so a frozen transition still lands right — and the folded panel is inert.
A row stores a colour key, resolved at render — theme-aware, palette-in-tokens.
Rail visibility and the colour choice are ephemeral; nothing enters persist or the outbox.
The nudge speaks only when the notes rail is away.
The keyboard yields to fields, tablists, sliders and open dialogs.
The pdf.js text-layer rules are quoted with their reason; --total-scale-factor is set at the integration point.
follow_up_tasks: Persist rail visibility per account and remember the last highlight colour (product calls; needs a preference home).
Let an existing highlight change colour (needs a repository update path + a row affordance).
The page-turn transient: a window slide can leave the previous page's canvas until the next paint.
The notes list could show each row's hue as a dot.
